fields: [pic=6]Wow! This sounds like a ton of work! Let me know if I can help!
[pic=1]Quite ambitious! I’d be happy to lend a paw too!
[pic=2]Thanks mates! But putting it together is part of the training!
[pic=4]Though perhaps havin’ ya clear out some trees wouldn’t be a bad idea…
[pic=3]It’s curious we haven’t found more shovels…
[pic=8]I’ll let Peter know to keep an eye out next time he’s out.
[pic=5]If I’m out training, I’ll be sure to keep an eye out too!
[pic=2]I got the OK a bit ago from Scarlett here, but just got crackin’ on it.
[pic=7]And sorry if we put you on the spot!
[pic=2]I’ll be able to do extensive workout routines! With proper flat ground and no potential hazards to worry about!
[pic=1]Could even run a course for ya guys, if ya’d like!
[pic=3]Whattya say? Wanna sweat and lose some pounds?
[pic=6]I’ll be honest dear, I don’t think I could keep up!
[pic=2]Yeah, sorry sonny! I’m a bit past my prime for that sorta thing!
[pic=2]I should be able to make a few courses of varying intensities, so everyone can have a go!
[pic=4]But that’s a bit away… First thing’s first! Gotta make it!
Oh right! I’ve got a Shovel!
Yeaaah, I’m not sure if that’s my thing…
[pic=2]Oy come on now, I bet ya’ve been rollin’ about all day, huh?
[pic=6]I can teach ya some more secrets if ya come train!
Errr, but it’s a shop order. From Maverick.
[pic=2]Great! I ordered one a bit ago!
[pic=6]I needed one to tend to the garden. I was out here grabbing some herbs I’d like to grow at home.
[pic=6]Lots of general spices that’s handy for all of the critters…
[pic=3]And I’ve got a new project underway…
[pic=3]I need to dig up a bunch of clay, and I’m basically stuck until I get a shovel…
[pic=4]And I need it for the training grounds…
I think Scarlett should have it.
[pic=7]I’ll be as quick as I can! Then I can pass it along!
[pic=1]Sounds good, I can help with the garden if ya’d like!
I think Bucky should have it.
[pic=3]Ya sure? I don’t mean to step on any toes…
[pic=2]Nonsense! Where would be without your help!
[pic=7]You can do what you need to, then pass it along.
I think Dustin should have it.
[pic=1]Yeah? I’ll be quick with it! Then I can pass it along!
[pic=2]I’m quite excited to see your project come along.
[pic=8]Hmmm, well, there’s not too much of a rush on my end.
[pic=2]The season just started after all, plenty of time for things to grow!
[pic=4]And, I wouldn’t mind a good excuse to take a break!
[pic=2]Works for me! I could use a breather after hulling all this junk!
[pic=2]Works for me! I could use a breather after hauling all this junk!
[pic=1]I’m excited to see it too! Always happy to see more craftsman critters!
[pic=4]Let me know if you need any help!
[pic=2]My back is a bit sore after fixing up that bridge…
[pic=2]Appreciate it mates! There’s heaps to do, so this’ll will help a lot!
[pic=1]After I’m done, I’ll pass it along!
